target_audience: UK adults discussing, taking, or considering weight loss medication
business_questions: What does UK weight loss medication conversation contain in the last 30 days, in what proportions, with what sentiment, and how much of it is about safety rather than results
Has the conversation moved from injection to oral pill, and what do people believe about whether the pill works as well as the shot
What almost stops people starting: the full objection and anxiety list, in their own words
How is the rising death and severe-reaction coverage being discussed, and does it change intent or only sentiment
How is hair loss discussed following the July study, and which side effects are talked about most
How is cost discussed once decomposed past the word: price level, price uncertainty, affordability, and grey-market sourcing
What is said about route to treatment: NHS eligibility, private pharmacy, supermarket pharmacy, and why people switch between them
What vocabulary do people actually use for the treatment, the experience, and the dose, including community jargon
How does stigma appear, and where does the conversation move to stay private
Which themes are condition-led and therefore usable in UK marketing, and which are drug-led and therefore not
additional_context: Study window 2026-07-07 to 2026-08-06, UK only. Corpus: Reddit and Mumsnet conversation, 400 UK news articles (Google News RSS, cleaned of a 139-article content farm and 28 investor-news items), and separately labelled customer reviews. Search terms were derived from 284 on-topic Google Trends related queries rather than chosen by intuition; three of five original intuition-led seed terms scored 1-2 out of 100 and were discarded. Dated events inside the window that shape the conversation: 18 July, national coverage of state-funded weight-loss jabs for children as young as six to twelve; 22 July, a study linking GLP-1 drugs to hair loss covered across UK press; 29 July, Plymouth inquest attributing a death to a weight loss drug; 3 August, oral Wegovy becomes available in the UK; 4 to 6 August, an escalating death-toll narrative running from a single inquest to reported totals of more than 100 and then 216 UK deaths with 18,000 severe reactions. Search interest for UK providers over the window: MedExpress 82, Bolt Pharmacy 65, Voy 31, Boots 24, Juniper 9. Reviews are held as a separate lane because every reviewer already converted and therefore cannot answer what stops people starting.
